text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Summer is nearly over. I'd say that training went rather well, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: More than anything else, we made great use of our time. I applaud your efforts, guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With that being said, we must not grow complacent! There are only two months until the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In that time, we'll need to perfect my physical form and fulfill every requirement for victory!
